description: Moved <meta charset>, viewport, X-UA-Compatible, theme-color to be the first tags in <head> (HTML spec compliance — must be in first 1024 bytes)
expected_impact: Faster early parsing and SEO; prevents charset reparse

description: Deferred GA4 (gtag.js) to load on first user interaction (scroll/click/touch/key/mouse) or after 3s timeout — matches existing GTM/Clarity/Bing pattern
expected_impact: Reduces TBT and main-thread blocking on initial load (~150ms+)

description: Added preconnect for cdn.shopify.com and www.googletagmanager.com; added dns-prefetch for cdn.jsdelivr.net, www.clarity.ms, checkout-merchant.snapmint.com
expected_impact: Saves ~100-200ms on third-party round-trips

description: Added defer attribute to slick-carousel JS loaded from jsdelivr (was render-blocking)
expected_impact: Removes render-blocking script on non-index/product pages

description: Slick-carousel CSS now uses media=print + onload swap pattern with noscript fallback (was render-blocking)
expected_impact: Removes render-blocking stylesheet

description: Snapmint payment script (mid=6233) now only loads on product/cart/checkout templates instead of every page
expected_impact: Saves ~50KB JS download on home/collection/blog/etc.

description: Merged three separate inline <style> blocks (.whatsapp FadeIn, article-only, main) into one block; removed extra whitespace within rules
expected_impact: Slightly smaller HTML payload and fewer style recalculations

description: Replaced broken inline aspect-ratio cascade (img position:absolute caused ancestor height collapse) with aspect-ratio:16/9 directly on .swiper-slide. Slide height is now reserved before Swiper initializes
expected_impact: Eliminates CLS 0.744 → ~0 on this section

description: Removed opacity:0 → carousel-ready hack. First slide now visible immediately on paint
expected_impact: Improves LCP timing for above-fold carousel

description: Replaced dual (desktop+mobile both eager+fetchpriority=high) with single element using on first slide. Browser fetches only the matching image
expected_impact: Saves one full image download (~200-500KB) on every visit

description: Removed legacy inline <style> that absolute-positioned images out of normal flow (was the root cause of the CLS chain)
expected_impact: Cleaner cascade; allows external CSS to drive layout

description: Extracted 4× duplicated chevron-down SVG paths into snippets icon-account-chevron-mb.liquid and icon-account-chevron-dec.liquid (rendered 2× each)
expected_impact: Reduces HTML payload by ~1KB per page and improves cacheability

description: Minified inline <style> block: removed comment, collapsed whitespace, single-line rules
expected_impact: Smaller HTML payload sent on every page

description: Gated cart-notification.js to only load when settings.cart_type == 'notification' (previously loaded on every page)
expected_impact: Saves a JS request when cart_type is drawer/page

description: Replaced render-blocking stylesheet_tag with media=print + onload swap and noscript fallback for section-image-banner.css
expected_impact: Removes render-blocking CSS request

description: Added explicit loading attribute to banner images: eager+fetchpriority=high when section.index==1 (LCP candidate); lazy otherwise
expected_impact: Saves bandwidth on stacked banners below the fold

description: Added decoding=async to both banner image tags
expected_impact: Decodes images off the main thread; reduces TBT during paint

description: Trimmed widths list from '375,550,750,1100,1500,1780,2000,3000,3840' to '375,550,750,1100,1500,1900,2400' (and ambient variant similarly). Drops oversized 4K+ variants
expected_impact: Smaller HTML payload; better Shopify CDN cache hit rate

description: Converted 4 render-blocking stylesheet_tag calls (section-image-banner, component-slider, component-slideshow, custom-slideshow) to media=print + onload swap with noscript fallback
expected_impact: Removes 4 render-blocking CSS requests on every page that uses slideshow
Massive HTML payload reduction (~70% on srcset); much better Shopify CDN cache hit rate

description: Mobile <source> now has full srcset (375w/550w/750w) and sizes=100vw instead of single fixed 600px width. Mobile devices now download right-sized image
expected_impact: Saves bandwidth on mobile; better visual quality on retina mobile

description: Consolidated per-slide overlay <style> tags (one per block) into a single {%- style -%} block at the top of the loop
expected_impact: Fewer style tags emitted; cleaner HTML

description: Added default values for first slide: loading defaults to 'eager', fetch_priority defaults to 'high' if section settings are blank. Previously empty admin fields produced empty attribute values
expected_impact: Prevents broken LCP on stores where admin left these settings unset

description: Fixed typo: was image_url width=1900 paired with 1920w descriptor; now uses Shopify image_tag filter which generates correct width/descriptor pairs
expected_impact: Correct image served at 1920w tier

description: Added decoding=async to slideshow image
expected_impact: Off-main-thread image decode; reduced TBT

description: Converted 6 render-blocking stylesheet_tag calls (section-footer, component-newsletter, component-list-menu, component-list-payment, component-list-social, site-footer) to media=print + onload swap with noscript fallback
expected_impact: Removes 6 render-blocking CSS requests on every page

description: Fixed CSS typo '.2scubic-bezier' → '.2s cubic-bezier(...)' on accordion icon transition (missing space caused the entire transition declaration to be invalid and ignored)
expected_impact: Restores broken accordion icon animation

description: Added aspect-ratio:564/168 (Google Play badge ratio) on .googleplay-icon img and .appstore-icon img alongside existing height:35px;width:auto. Reserves space before image loads
expected_impact: Prevents footer CLS on app-store icons

description: Moved per-link inline <script> for ticket-redirect logic outside the {%- for link -%} loop. Now renders once if any ticket link is present (was duplicated for every matching link). Wrapped in IIFE; cached customer JSON in a local var
expected_impact: Cleaner code; same behavior; smaller HTML when multiple links exist

description: Wrapped footer accordion <script> in an IIFE and added early-return guard on viewport width
expected_impact: Prevents global scope pollution; same behavior

description: Trimmed brand image srcset from 9 widths (50/100/150/200/300/400/550/800/1100) to 5 widths (100/200/400/550/800). Brand image is small and never needs 1100px source
expected_impact: Smaller HTML; better CDN cache hits

description: Added decoding=async to brand image
expected_impact: Off-main-thread decode

description: Tightened inline <style> block: collapsed multi-line rules to single line and removed empty lines
expected_impact: Smaller HTML payload sent on every page

description: Converted 7 render-blocking stylesheet_tag calls (component-card, component-price, component-slider, template-collection, quantity-selector-setup, mask-blobs conditional, quick-add conditional) to media=print + onload swap with single noscript fallback block
expected_impact: Removes up to 7 render-blocking CSS requests on every page that uses a featured collection section

description: Merged the standalone <style> block (custom-pdp + custom-collection-page-grid hover rules) into the existing {%- style -%} block. Tightened whitespace.
expected_impact: Smaller HTML payload; one less style tag to parse

description: Replaced bare tags with Shopify image_tag filter. Adds explicit width/height (from image properties), srcset (200/300/400/600), sizes=200px, alt, loading=lazy, decoding=async
expected_impact: Prevents CLS in slider; mobile gets right-sized images; off-main-thread decode

description: Added aria-hidden=true and tabindex=-1 to the duplicate-set blocks (used for seamless infinite scroll). Screen readers no longer announce items twice; keyboard users skip the duplicate links
expected_impact: Accessibility fix without changing visual behavior

description: Wrapped infinite scroll animation in @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference). Animation only runs for users who do NOT have reduced-motion preference
expected_impact: Respects user motion preference; saves CPU/battery on motion-sensitive users

description: Removed duplicate 'overflow: hidden' declaration in .slider-wrapper; merged .slider-wrapper rules into one block (was split with cursor:grab in a separate rule)
expected_impact: Cleaner CSS; same behavior

description: Promoted heading from <div class='slider-heading'> to <h2 class='slider-heading'>
expected_impact: SEO + accessibility (proper document outline)

description: Added will-change:transform to .slider-track to hint the browser to promote the animated layer
expected_impact: Smoother animation; less layout/paint cost
